title: DocMap status event (v12)
description: One status movement of a binder, a single document (contents item) or a box (location): 'Preso', 'Reinserito', 'Dato al Comune fino al…'. Append-only: never edited or deleted; an undo is a new event with undo_of. The current status of a target is its latest event (by at, then id) that is neither an undo nor undone. Stored in S.statusEvents, the SQLite table status_events (schema 9), workspace backups (key status_events), sync packages (records.status_events) and the server as records of type 'status_event'. Model: assets/js/02d-status.js (sqNormEvent). Contract: docs/MODELLO-DATI.md §17.

at.description: When it was recorded (ISO UTC, ms). Also the record updated_at on the server.

user.description: Display name of who recorded it (operator on the PC, signed-in user on the phone).

device.description: deviceId of the PC ('dev-…') or of the phone ('phone-…').

target_id.description: Binder id (also for a document) or location id (box).

doc_id.description: contents_items[].id of the document; '' unless target_type = document.

status_id.description: Id of the status type (settings.statusTypes, built-in: taken, returned, to_client, from_client, case, to_entity, from_entity, missing, found, check); '' for an undo.

holder.description: Who has it (person, client, council / agency), '' when the type asks nothing.

due_date.description: Expected return date YYYY-MM-DD or ''. Overdue = presence 'out' and due_date before today.

date.description: Effective date when it differs from at ('restituito il 3/11'), or ''.

via.description: scan = phone after a QR · box = 'Applica a tutta la scatola' · bulk = ticked binders · verify = 'Verifica rientro' · scanner = USB scanner 'Modalità stato' · editor = binder form.

box_id.description: Location id of the box the action went through ('' otherwise).

batch_id.description: Same value for every event of one user action on several targets ('' for a single target).

code.description: Speaking code (binder) or location code (box) at that time, for reports.

doc_text.description: 'year: description' of the document at that time ('' for binders and boxes).

undo_of.description: Id of the event this one cancels, '' otherwise.
